title: Large subject and a meta line; the conversation actions are in the window toolbar
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; open a conversation (Return)
Look at the title area, then use Done, Remind, Label, Trash, the up and down arrows and ⋯ in the toolbar
Open a conversation with a long subject
expected: The subject is 22 pt semibold with 'N messages · names' and labels in 12 pt grey under it; no buttons beside or under the subject. The toolbar holds Done, Remind, Label and Trash, then the up and down arrows (K, J) and ⋯ with Reply, Star, Snooze, Move, Mute and Print. With AI on the summary still ends 16 pt above the first message. A long subject wraps across the column.
